title: The Henderson
description:
The Henderson is a skyscraper in Central, Hong Kong

The Henderson is a skyscraper in Central, Hong Kong. The 36-storey building rises to a height of 190 metres (623 feet).It was designed by Zaha Hadid Architects. The site at 2 Murray Road was reportedly the world's most expensive plot, worth US$3 billion, when it was purchased by developer Henderson Land Development in 2017, leading to the demolition of the car park at the site.Construction began in 2019 and was completed in 2024.

The Henderson's occupancy rate reached 90% as of January 2026, with multinational companies and financial institutions among its notable tenants, including: global alternative investment firm Point72; secondary private assets market investor Coller Capital; global growth equity firm General Atlantic; hedge fund firm Aeonea; investment management company Cohen & Steers; law firm Akin Gump Strauss Hauer & Feld LLP; Japanese law firm Nishimura & Asahi; luxury watchmaker Audemars Piguet; and art and luxury auction house Christie's[8].

title: Women and Families Hospital, Temple University Health System
description: Development of the Women and Families Hospital at Temple University Health System, featuring state-of-the-art maternal and infant care facilities. The project involved intensive BIM coordination for specialized healthcare MEP systems.

title: BPA Ross Complex Redevelopment
description:
BPA Ross Complex Redevelopment – Technical Services Building (TSB)


A modern federal utility facility redevelopment project utilizing BIM coordination workflows for architectural, structural, and MEP disciplines. The project focused on multidisciplinary coordination, clash detection, system integration, and construction documentation to support efficient project delivery and improved facility performance.

BIM Scope: Architectural BIM, Structural Coordination, MEP Coordination, Clash Detection, and Construction Documentation.
LOD: 350–400 (Coordination Model) | 500 (As-Built Documentation)

title: Amazon Distribution Center – Electrical BIM Design & Coordination
description:
Amazon Distribution Center – Electrical BIM Design & Coordination


This project involved the development of a detailed Electrical BIM model for a large-scale industrial distribution center. The scope included power distribution systems, lighting layouts, electrical equipment coordination, cable tray and conduit routing, and integration with architectural, structural, and MEP disciplines. Using BIM workflows, the project team performed clash detection, system coordination, and construction documentation to improve design accuracy, reduce installation conflicts, and support efficient project execution. The electrical model was developed to LOD 400 standards for detailed coordination and construction support.

title: Harbor Heights Multifamily Podium – Structural BIM Modeling & Coordination
description:
Harbor Heights Multifamily Podium – Structural BIM Modeling & Coordination



This project involved the development of a comprehensive Structural BIM model for a multi-story multifamily residential building with a concrete podium structure. The BIM workflow included structural framing, columns, beams, slabs, foundations, and coordination with architectural and MEP systems. The model was created to support design accuracy, clash detection, construction planning, and seamless coordination between project disciplines. Developed at LOD 350–400, the BIM model helped minimize construction conflicts and improve overall project efficiency.

title: Metropolitan Wastewater Treatment Facility Expansion
description:
Metropolitan Wastewater Treatment Facility Expansion – Scan-to-BIM



This large-scale wastewater treatment facility expansion project involved converting laser scan data and point cloud information into an accurate BIM model of the existing facility. The scope included structural elements, mechanical equipment, process piping systems, electrical components, and utility coordination. The Scan-to-BIM workflow supported renovation planning, clash detection, facility upgrades, and long-term asset management. The BIM model was developed at LOD 300–400 standards to provide a reliable digital representation of the infrastructure facility.

title: New Text Document
description:
Federal Government Courthouse – Structural BIM Detailing

Project Type: Government Facility / Courthouse

This project involved the development of a detailed Structural BIM model for a modern government courthouse facility. The BIM scope included structural steel framing, concrete elements, foundations, beams, columns, slabs, and connection detailing. The model supported design coordination, structural analysis, clash detection, and construction documentation while ensuring accurate integration with architectural and MEP systems. The structural model was developed to LOD 350–400 standards to improve constructability, reduce conflicts, and support efficient project delivery

title: Hyperscale Data Center Campus
description:
Hyperscale Data Center Campus – MEP & Structural BIM Coordination



This project involved the development of a comprehensive BIM model for a large-scale hyperscale data center facility. The BIM scope included structural steel framing, concrete elements, foundations, HVAC cooling systems, electrical power distribution, cable tray systems, fire protection, and equipment coordination. The integrated BIM workflow supported multidisciplinary coordination, clash detection, constructability reviews, and installation planning for a mission-critical environment. The models were developed to LOD 350–400 standards to improve accuracy, minimize construction conflicts, and ensure efficient project delivery.

title: Corporate Office Fit-Out Engineering Design
description:
Project Name: Corporate Headquarters Office Fit-Out 


This project involved the engineering design and BIM coordination of a modern corporate office fit-out, including interior layouts, HVAC systems, electrical distribution, lighting design, plumbing systems, and architectural elements. The BIM workflow supported multidisciplinary coordination, space optimization, clash detection, and construction documentation. The integrated BIM model was developed to improve design accuracy, reduce installation conflicts, and support efficient project execution. The project was coordinated at LOD 350–400 standards for detailed design and construction support.

title: Central Railway Transit Hub
description:
Central Railway Transit Hub – 
Project Type: Transportation Infrastructure / Railway Station


This project involved the creation of a detailed Scan-to-BIM model for an existing railway transit hub undergoing modernization and infrastructure upgrades. Laser scanning technology was utilized to capture accurate existing conditions, which were converted into a coordinated BIM environment. The project included architectural modeling, structural assessment, MEP system coordination, and documentation development to support renovation planning, construction execution, and long-term facility management.
